name: Shael'dryn
summary: Beside the Moonwell of Purity, Shael'dryn watches corruption spread through Ashenvale. East of Iris Lake, she aids night elf scouts and Astranaar's sentinels with relics tainted by demonic and foul influences.

sections.title: Guardian of the Moonwell
sections.body: Beside the Moonwell of Purity, Shael'dryn watches the forest's eastern approaches with the night elf sentinels. When corruption touches local wildlife or tainted relics threaten the land's harmony, she draws on her deep understanding of nature to guide adventurers in restoring spiritual balance.

sections.title: Purification of the Woods
sections.body: Shael'dryn works with Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. When sentinels recover tainted artifacts, including corrupted glowing gems and lost pieces of Dartol's Rod, she knows the obscure rituals, moonwell waters, and natural tokens needed to purify them. The artifacts become potent cleansing tools for the Alliance.

faq.answer: Shael'dryn is a dryad beside the Moonwell of Purity in Ashenvale. She shares woodland lore and natural magic with Alliance adventurers, along with puns and jokes.
Shael'dryn waits beside the Moonwell of Purity, east of Iris Lake in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is Shael'dryn's connection to Raene Wolfrunner?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner directs adventurers to Shael'dryn for her spiritual knowledge. She helps investigate and cleanse corrupted gems and relics recovered throughout the forest.

faq.q: What is unique about Shael'dryn's appearance?
faq.answer: Shael'dryn and her fellow dryad Illiyana share an uncommon coloration that sets them apart from most other dryads encountered across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Is Shael'dryn friendly to the Horde?
faq.answer: No. Shael'dryn stands beside the Moonwell of Purity and is closely allied with the Astranaar Sentinels. She is hostile toward members of the Horde.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you can welcome Shael'dryn as a sister of the forest. Her natural ties to Cenarius make her indispensable when cleansing tainted woodland relics.
As a druid, you can value Shael'dryn's natural connection to the spirits of Kalimdor and her insight into restoring flora and fauna warped by dark powers.
As an Alliance member, you can look to the Moonwell of Purity as a sanctuary in Ashenvale. Shael'dryn aids Alliance forces resisting corruption and hostile encroachment.
